question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a black ball, Claire has a teal ball, Dave has a gold ball, Eve has a silver ball, Fred has a brown ball, and Gertrude has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Finally, Bob and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) black ball
(C) teal ball
(D) gold ball
(E) silver ball
(F) brown ball
(G) orange ball
solution:
Ball colors in every row are listed for (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (grey, black, teal, gold, silver, brown, orange).
1. Alice and Eve swap: (silver, black, teal, gold, grey, brown, orange).
2. Dave and Eve swap: (silver, black, teal, grey, gold, brown, orange).
3. Eve and Dave swap: (silver, black, teal, gold, grey, brown, orange).
4. Eve and Dave swap: (silver, black, teal, grey, gold, brown, orange).
5. Gertrude and Dave swap: (silver, black, teal, orange, gold, brown, grey).
6. Bob and Alice swap: (black, silver, teal, orange, gold, brown, grey).
7. Bob and Eve swap: (black, gold, teal, orange, silver, brown, grey).
Fred has the brown ball, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
